title: GTA 6 studio Rockstar votes down union deal 🗳️
subject: rockstar
description:
What do you make of the result? 👇

Rockstar Games employees in the UK voted 75% against a recognition agreement with the IWGB union in a ballot held from November 12 to November 26, 2026. 1,544 employees voted, a turnout of just over 93%. Rockstar said the result reflects support for direct relationships with its team; the union said it will keep organising. A Glasgow employment tribunal over Rockstar's October 2025 dismissal of more than 30 staff has not yet ruled.

Sources: PC Gamer (Nov 26, 2026), Kotaku (Nov 26, 2026), Wccftech (Nov 26, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Rockstar's UK staff have voted down a union deal.
The ballot ran from November 12 to 26, right through the GTA 6 launch.
Of 1,544 employees who voted, 75% rejected a recognition deal with the IWGB union.
Turnout was over 93%. The deal would have covered overtime, bonuses, layoffs and AI.
Rockstar's Jennifer Kolbe said the result reflects support for direct relationships with the team.
The union says it will keep organising. A Glasgow tribunal over the 2025 firings still hasn't ruled.
